source_facts.fact: SessionObservationReader returns a live-preferred immutable observation with a fixed cursor, inheritedEventCount, cloned/prepared events, optional cancellation, and a disposable lease. The live lease captures session.seq before lazily materializing its prefix, so later appends cannot enter the captured cut.
SessionQueryEngine.observeSession(sessionId, options) already exposes the observation seam and propagates AbortSignal through live or persisted resolution.
The extension registry passes the request AbortSignal to providers and stops awaiting provider preparation after cancellation.
The base composition mounts the session-query SQLite provider.

The minimal SDK composition mounts session-log-deepseek but no session-query provider, so the migration must keep an explicit compatibility path there until composition changes are separately accepted.
Persistence handles support offset/length reads and cancellation, but do not expose a stable page token or immutable end cursor; this slice does not invent one for the live upload path.

decision.selected: Use the optional SessionQueryEngine observation seam for session-log-deepseek preparation when the service is mounted. Require source === live, retain the observation lease through wire conversion, fold acceptance markers from the captured events, derive throughSeq from the fixed observation cursor, and dispose the lease in all paths.
decision.compatibility: When session-query is unavailable, preserve the existing minimal-profile behavior behind one explicit retained legacy path. Do not silently read persisted history for a request that previously required a live Session.
wire_invariants: The dsh_session_log version, sessionFormatVersion, header, afterSeq, throughSeq, event order, raw numeric sequence fields, surface operations, and sourceEventSeqs remain unchanged.
The captured throughSeq is the observation cursor, so appends after preparation never enter the outgoing suffix.
A matching session id and format generation remain required for acceptance watermarks; inherited parent markers remain ignored by forked sessions.
Acceptance still appends the same durable delivery-accepted event and performs no independent I/O.
rejected: A new synchronous Session history wrapper: it would rename the deprecated read without changing ownership or cancellation semantics.
Direct persistence paging in session-log-deepseek: it lacks a stable end cursor for the existing live-only request behavior and would duplicate session-query source resolution.
Making session-query mandatory in sdk-minimal: it would change the minimal profile dependency surface and remove a supported composition without an explicit bundle decision.

required_cases: Base composition uses the observation path and produces byte-equivalent wire fields for a fixed live cut.
Appending after observation capture does not change throughSeq or the prepared suffix.
Cancellation before and during observation propagates the request abort without publishing a partial field.
Seeded/forked sessions retain inherited-prefix and matching-session-id watermark behavior.
sdk-minimal or a context without session-query preserves the current fallback behavior and its local retained reason.
The observation lease is disposed on success, omission, cancellation, and conversion failure.
required_checks: Focused session-log-deepseek upload and feedback-composition tests
dependency and generated API/catalog checks if package metadata or public declarations change
canonical metric command on a complete candidate tree

limitations: A06 is a design action; no production implementation or bundle composition change was made.

The preserved custom/main worktree still has 12 tracked source deletions that prevent the canonical audit-metrics command from completing; A07 must validate metrics on a complete candidate or retain the same explicit limitation.
The sealed A28 candidate remains unchanged and is not yet rebuilt for this design.
decision_summary: Accept the optional observation-based W1 reader design and enter A07 implementation with the task-bound gate; keep complete-history and minimal-profile fallback reads explicitly retained until equivalent evidence exists.
